name: Spawning Canker Sheriff
body:
Spawning Canker Sheriff
CR 10*

XP 9,600
CE Medium aberration (mythos)
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +15

DEFENSE

AC 26, touch 17, flat-footed 19 (+3 armor, +6 Dex, +1 dodge, +6 natural)
hp 115 (10d8+70)
Fort +12, Ref +11, Will +9
Immune mind-affecting effects

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee +1 keen scimitar +16/+11 (1d6+9/15–20), slam +10 (1d6+4), tentacle +10 (1d8+4 plus grab) or 2 slams +15 (1d6+8), tentacle +10 (1d8+4 plus grab)
Ranged +1 composite longbow (+4 Str) +14/+9 (1d8+5/x3)
Special Attacks constrict (1d8+4), feeding

STATISTICS

Str 26, Dex 23, Con 24, Int 7, Wis 14, Cha 17
Base Atk +7; CMB +15 (+19 grapple); CMD 32
Feats Dodge, Great Fortitude, Lightning Reflexes, Mobility, Power Attack
Skills Perception +15, Stealth +24
Languages Aklo
Gear potion of cure light wounds, +1 shadow leather armor, +1 keen scimitar, masterwork handaxe, +1 composite longbow (+4 Str), 2 human slaying arrows, 2 orc slaying arrows, elf slaying arrow, monstrous humanoid slaying arrow, 10 red-fletched arrows
